description: Estacionamiento regulado en Viladecans is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by viladecans.cat. Regulated parking in Viladecans is a set of geographical information regarding the location of the streets and the type of regulated car parks in the municipality of Viladecans. The spatial representation of this data is carried out by means of a plan in PDF format. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Regulated parking in Viladecans" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Viladecans, Transport planning, Automòbil, Europe, Catalunya, Car park. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
